 A little planning around the 2027 holiday calendar could turn 10 vacation days into several extended breaks, including two nine-day stretches.
 Roddy Cons twitter Digital sports journalist About the author Scottish sports journalist and content creator. After running his own soccer-related projects, in 2022 he joined Diario AS, where he mainly reports on the biggest news from around Europe’s leading soccer clubs, Liga MX and MLS, and covers live games in a not-too-serious tone. Likes to mix things up by dipping into the world of American sports. Update: Nov 20th, 2026 09:24 EST 0 Share facebook twitter whatsapp Make us preferred on Google The start of 2027 is just a matter of weeks away, so you may already have planned your holidays and time off for at least some of next year, or be in the process of doing so. If you fall into the latter category, here are a few things to keep in mind.
 Obviously, holidays very much depend on the sector you work in, the company you work for and your schedule. But let’s imagine you’re doing the old-fashioned Monday-to-Friday grind and normally have weekends off , just like in the good old days.
 If you’re lucky, your employer may observe all 11 federal holidays , although that’s not always the norm across the private sector, admittedly. If that is the case, though, you could use 10 PTO days to get a total of 50 days off in 2027, as highlighted by Vacation Tracker. 
 There are 11 federal holidays in 2027:
 New Year’s Day: Friday, Jan. 1, 2027 
 Birthday of Martin Luther King, Jr.: Monday, Jan. 18, 2027 
 Washington’s Birthday (Presidents Day): Monday, Feb. 15, 2027 
 Memorial Day: Monday, May 31, 2027 
 Juneteenth National Independence Day: Saturday, June 19, 2027 (observed Friday, June 18, 2027) 
 Independence Day: Sunday, July 4, 2027 (observed Monday, July 5, 2027) 
 Labor Day: Monday, Sept. 6, 2027 
 Columbus Day: Monday, Oct. 11, 2027 
 Veterans Day: Thursday, Nov. 11, 2027 
 Thanksgiving Day: Thursday, Nov. 25, 2027 
 Christmas Day: Saturday, Dec. 25, 2027 (observed Friday, Dec. 24, 2027) 
 Most of those federal holidays give you three days off , including the weekend. The trick is to make the most of the two that fall on Thursdays .
 How to get 50 days off using 10 PTO days
 The best strategy, according to Vacation Tracker, is to focus the majority of your PTO in November, either side of Veterans Day and Thanksgiving , which both fall on a Thursday in 2027.
 By requesting four days off in each of those weeks (Nov. 8-10 and Nov. 12, followed by Nov. 22-24 and Nov. 26) , you’ll be able to use four PTO days to get nine days off, including weekends, twice.
 If you add New Year’s Day 2028 into the mix, you can get a five-day break by taking Dec. 29 and 30 off. 
 All in all, that totals 50 days across breaks using just 10 PTO days . That time off is split into nine breaks of three days, one break of five days and two breaks of nine days.
 What if your employer only observes six federal holidays?
 On the other hand, many companies only observe the core set of six federal holidays: 
 New Year’s Day: Friday, Jan. 1, 2027 
 Memorial Day: Monday, May 31, 2027 
 Independence Day: Sunday, July 4, 2027 
 Labor Day: Monday, Sept. 6, 2027 
 Thanksgiving Day: Thursday, Nov. 25, 2027 
 Christmas Day: Saturday, Dec. 25, 2027 (observed Friday, Dec. 24, 2027) 
 If your employer falls into that category, you can still get 35 days off across breaks using 10 PTO days. However, you’ll need to spread those days out a little differently. Keep the four around Thanksgiving , then use four more immediately before Christmas (Dec. 21-24) and the remaining two between Christmas and New Year. 
 That gives you two nine-day breaks, four three-day breaks and one five-day break, which is still not too shabby.
 Of course, you may be fortunate and be able to maximize your time off even further with additional PTO days. But it’s always worth planning ahead and booking your time off in advance to ensure you get the rest you deserve and, let’s face it, probably need.
